_doc: House wording for economic calendar rows, keyed by investing.com's English event name without the trailing period (e.g. '(Oct)'). Read by scripts/cal_fetch.py. Sources: the rows the S6 stage wrote in the 24 Nov 2026 replay (calendar.md forms: EN country prefix, AR country first with an en dash), calendar.md's fixed crude rows, and ar_glossary.json for the client-mandated API row. 'nofig': true writes Prior and Estimation as the blank marker (crude rows, user 21 Oct 2026). Add a row here when a new event first appears; the latest final decks decide the wording.
